params.body:
Merge **after** gentells-site #230, which cuts the list per reader.

The trends projection sent six signals per trend (`getInsightSignalSample` with its default limit), so gentells.com could show no more than six, even to an Intelligence reader, under "+ 47 more signals feed this trend".

- New `packages/core/trend-signals.mjs`: `trendSignalsForSite` returns every signal of the trend, capped at 300, ordered as before: signals with a link first, then by relevance.
- A signal from a source read for inspiration only is left out. Before this, the six-signal sample could carry a YPulse link to gentells.com.
- `heavy.mjs` (`projection-trends`) uses it, and reads the flagged sources once per run. `signals_more` is still the trend's signal count minus what is sent.

Tests: `test/trend-signals-projection.test.mjs`: twelve signals go, the YPulse one does not. Full suite 1336/1342; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need pdftoppm.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Trends go to the site with every signal
